summary.one_liner: A community-written handbook of tips for surviving and improving on-call rotations, organized into sections on pager setup, on-call kit, general preparation, optimizing rotations, and relaxation.
summary.what_it_does: The README introduces itself as a collection of tips and tricks for getting through an on-call rotation, drawn from people who have done it. It is aimed at first-time on-call engineers as well as experienced ones who want to see how others handle their rotations. The content is split into five headed sections: I. Pager Setup, II. On-call Kit, III. General Prep, IV. Optimizing Rotations, and V. Relaxation. The README itself contains only the section titles and an intro, so the actual tips are not visible in the text provided. It invites pull requests to add more material.
use_cases: setting up a pager for a new on-call rotation
preparing a kit or checklist before going on-call
getting ready for a first on-call shift
making a heavy on-call rotation more manageable
reviewing what other engineers do during on-call
notable: Written by people who have worked on-call, per the README
Covers the full on-call lifecycle from pager setup to relaxation
Open to community contributions via pull requests
Listed under the On-Call section of dastergon/awesome-sre
caveats: The README provided contains only section headings and an intro; the detailed tips are not included in the text shown
